assign.request: A deletion task: ext/Panel's workspace.js back under 200 lines with no capability lost — the first objective is clean, simple solutions Mike can open and understand.
steps: Read workspace.js and name its distinct responsibilities
Extract by responsibility, not by line count
Docs and readme follow the new shape

log.msg: Four cuts, chosen by responsibility: vocab.js (what a document was opened with — vocab/offer/standard/tools), focus.js (the selection and the three ways it is lost), overlays.js (the four surfaces on a leaf body + the disposer registry), paint.js (paint/repaint/show/views + the mirror walk). workspace.js keeps the two doors, the redraw and the recursive view().

Imports all flow one way: workspace.js -> {vocab, focus, overlays, paint}; focus/overlays/paint -> vocab; none reads workspace.js back. vocab.js is the bottom of the graph, which is what lets a leaf resolve its vocabulary without importing the door.
roll() and the drawing flag deliberately stayed together in workspace.js — a module-scope flag with two users (draw and roll) cannot be split without an import in one direction or the other.

workspace.js 365 -> 198 lines. New: vocab.js 28, focus.js 61, overlays.js 49, paint.js 76. Module total 2582 -> 2631 (+49, all of it file headers). Public door unchanged — workspace.js re-exports vocab/tools/focused/repaint/show, so ext/files/panels.js and properties.js were not touched.

Proof: per-workspace surface census on /framework/ext/Panel/full/ (9 mounts), /framework/ext/Panel/ (8) and /framework/ext/editor/ (2) is byte-identical before and after — main mount 54 panels / 34 bodies / 34 align / 136 edges / 20 insert / 34 display / 34 zoom / 15 repeat tiles. ext/editor's own workspace still at 0 align, 0 edge, 0 insert, 0 display, 0 zoom (repeat stays on: it is not in its tools override).

Observers flat over 20 structural redraws, before and after: /full/ 96 MutationObservers + 59 ResizeObservers live, unchanged; /Panel/ 90 + 56; /editor/ 2 + 2. All 34 bodies provably rebuilt each redraw (marked bodies, 0 survivors). Zero console errors on all three pages, and on /framework/, space/compose and ext/files.

Behaviour probe: click focuses exactly 1 panel, Escape clears it, panel-unfocus clears it; a change kept all 34 bodies (no structural redraw); an add rebuilt everything (+1 panel); writing a master repainted exactly 2 of 35 bodies (master + copy) and nobody else. /data/panels.json untouched — md5 c3d5d115 before and after, mtime 05:13.

**workspace.js 365 -> 198 lines, four responsibilities extracted, nothing changed.**

`ext/Panel/workspace.js` now holds only the two doors, the redraw and the recursive `view()`. What came out, each named for what it is and each read by `workspace.js` without reading it back:

| file | lines | what it is |
|---|---|---|

| [`focus.js`](/framework/ext/Panel/files/) | 61 | the selection, and the three ways it is lost |
| [`overlays.js`](/framework/ext/Panel/files/) | 49 | the four surfaces on a leaf body, and the disposer registry `draw()` drains |
| [`paint.js`](/framework/ext/Panel/files/) | 76 | one panel's own DOM — `paint`/`repaint`/`show`/`views`, and the mirror walk |

Module total 2,582 -> 2,631 (+49, all of it file headers). The public door is unchanged — `workspace.js` re-exports `vocab`/`tools`/`focused`/`repaint`/`show`, so `ext/files/panels.js` and `properties.js` were not touched.

**Proof nothing changed.** Per-workspace surface census byte-identical before and after on [`/full/`](/framework/ext/Panel/full/) (9 mounts), [`/framework/ext/Panel/`](/framework/ext/Panel/) (8) and [`ext/editor`](/framework/ext/editor/) (2): main mount 54 panels, 34 bodies, 34 align grids, 136 edge zones, 20 insert bars, 34 display overlays, 34 zoom buttons, 15 repeat tiles. ext/editor's own workspace still draws 0 align / 0 edge / 0 insert / 0 display / 0 zoom. Observers flat across 20 structural redraws, before and after: 96 MutationObservers + 59 ResizeObservers live on `/full/`, with all 34 bodies provably rebuilt each pass. Zero console errors on six pages. `/data/panels.json` untouched.
